findings.contract_clause: SERVICE.md: Input scan field expects an object
findings.detail: The atom returned a 200 OK with an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity for malformed input.

notes: The atom correctly handles logic for full-pass, violations, and sparse cases. However, it fails to implement proper HTTP error handling for malformed input, returning a 200 OK with a default verdict instead of the required 422 status code.
